mapper.sql: f.id, f.user_id, f.category, f.title, f.content, f.contact, f.status, f.admin_reply, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.replied_at, f.user_read_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_feedback (user_id, category, title, content, contact, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contact}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_feedback SET status = #{status}, admin_reply = #{adminReply}, updated_at = NOW(), replied_at = CASE WHEN #{refreshReply} THEN NOW() ELSE replied_at END, user_read_at = CASE WHEN #{refreshReply} THEN NULL ELSE user_read_at END WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND admin_reply IS NOT NULL AND admin_reply != '' AND (user_read_at IS NULL OR user_read_at < replied_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_feedback SET user_read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND admin_reply IS NOT NULL AND admin_reply != ''
